**An overview of this role**
----------------------------

As the Candidate Experience Team Lead for [Region], you'll own how candidates experience GitLab across your region by raising the capability of the specialists around you. You'll set the quality bar, balance workloads, onboard and develop specialists, and serve as the first escalation point when a process breaks down or a candidate situation needs judgment. You'll stay hands-on with interview coordination, background checks, and offers, while spending most of your time making the regional function run well. Job Description:
  
  
SAP S/4HANA Senior Consultant
  
Controlling — Product Cost / Actual Cost (CO-PC / CO-AC) and Profitability & Margin Analysis
  
SAP S/4HANA Implementation Program |
  
  
TOP 4 JOB REQUIREMENTS FOR THIS ROLE
  
1. Hands-on SAP Material Ledger implementation — activation, actual costing run, multi-level price determination, periodic unit price and actual cost component split. A hard requirement, not a nice-to-have.
  
2. Product Cost Controlling depth — costing variants and estimates, costing sheets, WIP, variance calculation and order settlement.
  
3. Replacing a spreadsheet costing process — codifying multi-tier allocation and derivation rules into a governed system layer, and running a formal six-month parallel run to sign-off.
  
4. Margin analysis and finance-facing communication — account-based CO-PA design, plus the ability to explain a costing result to CFO-level stakeholders in business terms.
  
  
ROLE OVERVIEW
  
Actual cost today is produced entirely in Excel: SAP supplies only a raw variance extract, while product-number conversion, three-tier variance allocation, series derivation, category-based spending and absorption rules, sub-to-main mapping and quarter-end averaging live in spreadsheets maintained by a few individuals. The month-end process is long, the audit trail thin, and the logic carries real key-person risk. The target is SAP Material Ledger actual costing in collection-only mode — periodic unit price calculated and rolled up multi-level through the BOM for management reporting, while inventory remain at standard cost. Delivery includes a six-month parallel run before Excel is retired.
  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
• Lead Controlling validation workshops with the manufacturing controller and finance leadership; confirm the requirements and produce signed-off functional design.
  
• Configure Material Ledger actual costing in collection-only mode: ML activation per plant, currency and valuation setup, single- and multi-level price determination, and deliberate exclusion of post-closing so there is no financial-statement impact.
  
• Design the periodic unit price and multi-level roll-up so raw-material and semi-finished variances propagate through the full BOM to finished goods, with the actual cost component split carried through to allocation and reporting.
  
• Map the nine cost-variance GL accounts onto standard variance categories and ML cost components; design the business-specific allocation logic — direct-by-item, pooled ratio distribution by plant and business area, business-area-only vendor discount allocation, series derivation, category-based spending and absorption, sub-to-main mapping and quarter-end averaging.
  
• Take and document the architecture decision — reposting custom allocation into Material Ledger versus combining it with the ML periodic unit price in the reporting layer — before custom development begins; drive upstream posting-quality remediation as the primary lever.
BATCH MANAGEMENT & TRACEABILITY EXPERIENCE — PREFERRED, NOT REQUIRED
  
Batch Management and traceability experience is preferred but not required for this role — the actual-costing scope is item-level rather than batch-level. Candidates who understand the following will integrate more effectively with the manufacturing and inventory workstreams:
  
• How batch-managed inventory and batch valuation interact with Material Ledger — including split and batch-specific valuation, and why this program's collection-only design does not require them.
  
• FIFO lot-based gross-profit reporting (deferred to a later phase here) and the batch-level data it would depend on.
  
• How scrap and yield reported at lot and batch level in execution flow into production-order variance and therefore into actual cost, so costing and shop-floor reporting design stay consistent.
  
  
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
  
• 8+ years SAP Controlling consulting with minimum 2 full-lifecycle implementations and hands-on Product Cost Controlling configuration responsibility; at least 2 on S/4HANA (1909 or later).
  
• Demonstrable hands-on SAP Material Ledger implementation experience — activation, actual costing run, single- and multi-level price determination, periodic unit price, actual cost component split and CKM3N/CKMVFM analysis. This is a hard requirement.
  
• Deep Product Cost Planning and Cost Object Controlling expertise: costing variants, cost estimates, costing sheets, WIP, variance calculation and settlement.
  
• Profitability analysis experience — margin analysis (account-based CO-PA) on S/4HANA, characteristic derivation, and product/customer-level margin reporting.
  
• Actual costing in report-only / collection-only mode, or the clear ability to explain the design implications of not running post-closing.
  
• Proven replacement of a spreadsheet-based finance process with a system process, including running a formal parallel run and securing sign-off.
  
• Strong CO–FI–MM–PP integration knowledge, SOX / J-SOX control experience, and the ability to explain a costing result to CFO-level stakeholders in business terms.
  
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:
  
• Delivering costing allocation logic in a governed BW / SAP BTP reporting layer rather than bespoke ABAP.
  
• SAP Analytics Cloud or SAP Business Data Cloud for margin and cost reporting.
  
• Group Reporting, Universal Parallel Accounting or multi-valuation actual costing.
  
• Electronics or high-mix discrete manufacturing cost structures, including mold/tooling and engineer-to-order costing; ML performance tuning and month-end runtime benchmarking at scale.
  
• SAP certification in S/4HANA Management Accounting (Controlling).

* Track resource joining dates, deployment schedules and assignment status.

* Coordinate resource replacements, contract modifications and offboarding activities.
* Address operational queries and escalate client or contractor concerns when required.

* Maintain accurate records of all deployed contractors, consultants and employees.
* Track resource allocation, utilisation, assignment duration and bench availability.
* Monitor contract start dates, end dates, extensions and renewal deadlines.
* Proactively coordinate with clients and account managers regarding upcoming contract expirations.
* Support workforce planning and resource allocation requirements.
* Maintain regular communication with deployed resources to address operational concerns and improve engagement.

**4. Compliance & Contract Documentation**

* Ensure all contractor agreements, employment documents and client-specific compliance requirements are completed.

**5. Timesheet, Attendance & Billing Coordination**

* Collect and validate contractor timesheets and attendance records.
* Follow up with clients and contractors for timely timesheet submissions and approvals.
* Coordinate with finance teams for invoice preparation and billing accuracy.
* Track billable hours, approved leave, resource utilisation and contract-related changes.
* Resolve discrepancies in attendance, timesheets and billing information.

**6. Reporting & Stakeholder Management**

* Maintain staffing trackers, resource deployment reports and contractor databases.
* Prepare weekly and monthly reports on active resources, bench strength, contract renewals and deployment status.
* Maintain accurate MIS reports using Microsoft Excel.
* Coordinate with internal recruitment, HR, payroll, finance and account management teams.
* Support process improvements to increase operational efficiency and minimise resource deployment delays.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Graduate in any discipline.
* **Minimum 4–5 years of relevant experience in staff augmentation, contract staffing operations or workforce management.**
* Strong understanding of the complete contract staffing lifecycle, from onboarding to offboarding.

title: Administrative Support Specialist
description:
The ERP Project Data & Administrative Support Specialist is responsible for the accurate and timely processing of laboratory testing unit transactions into the company's Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system through batch uploads. The position supports the administrative processing of laboratory testing activities by ensuring that units are properly recorded and charged to the appropriate consulting projects.

A primary responsibility is to monitor ERP batch upload results, review system-generated error reports, and coordinate the resolution of rejected or incorrectly charged transactions. Working closely with project controllers and utilizing the project database, the position will research identified discrepancies, facilitate necessary data corrections, and resubmit corrected transactions into the ERP system.

This position operates as an administrative support function from an offshore or international location and requires regular access to the ERP system, project database, and communication channels with project controllers. Accuracy, attention to detail, consistency, and timely follow-through are essential to maintaining the integrity of project-related transactions.

  

1. ERP Batch Upload Processing

* Prepare and execute routine batch uploads of laboratory testing units into the ERP system.
* Ensure upload files are complete, properly formatted, and consistent with established data requirements.
* Validate source data against required upload fields and established procedures prior to submission.
* Monitor batch upload results and confirm successful processing of transactions.
* Maintain records of completed uploads, including upload dates, batch references, transaction counts, and processing status.
* Escalate system access, formatting, or technical issues that prevent successful uploads.

2. ERP Error Report Review and Resolution

* Retrieve and review ERP-generated error reports following each batch upload.
* Identify units that were rejected, not processed, or incorrectly charged to consulting projects.
* Categorize errors based on the nature of the discrepancy, such as missing project information, invalid project codes, incorrect data, or other ERP validation issues.
* Research discrepancies using the project database and available transaction information.
* Coordinate with the appropriate project controllers to investigate and obtain direction on required corrections.
* Update or coordinate corrections to source data based on guidance and authorization from project controllers.
* Maintain an organized tracking log of outstanding errors, corrective actions, responsible parties, and resolution status.

3. Correction and Resubmission

* Prepare corrected transaction records following confirmation of the required changes.
* Revalidate corrected data to ensure it meets ERP upload requirements.
* Resubmit corrected transactions through the ERP batch upload process.
* Review subsequent ERP processing reports to confirm successful posting and proper project charging.
* Continue follow-up on unresolved errors until successful processing is confirmed.
* Escalate recurring or unresolved issues to the appropriate project controller or supervisor.

4. Reporting and Administrative Coordination

* Maintain accurate records of upload activity, error resolution, and resubmission results.
* Provide periodic status reports summarizing upload volumes, error rates, outstanding items, and resolution progress.
* Communicate regularly with project controllers to obtain clarification and facilitate timely error resolution.
* Identify recurring data quality issues and recommend improvements to the upload and error resolution process.
* Follow established data security, confidentiality, and internal control procedures when accessing company systems and project information.

  

* Associate degree or equivalent administrative/business experience preferred.
* 1–3 years of experience in administrative operations, data processing, transaction processing, or ERP system support.
* Experience working with ERP systems; experience with [SAP / Oracle / Other ERP] is a plus.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including sorting, filtering, data validation, and working with large data files.
* Experience reviewing system-generated reports and identifying data discrepancies.
* Strong data entry accuracy and attention to detail.
* Ability to follow established procedures and manage repetitive, high-volume administrative transactions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with colleagues and project controllers located in different countries and time zones.
* Professional proficiency in English.

Key Competencies

* Accuracy and Attention to Detail: Ensures transaction data is complete and accurate before submission.
* Problem Solving: Able to investigate data discrepancies and identify the information needed to resolve errors.
* Organization and Follow-Through: Maintains clear tracking of rejected transactions through final resolution.
* Communication: Effectively coordinates with project controllers and internal stakeholders.
* Process Discipline: Consistently follows established upload, correction, approval, and resubmission procedures.
* Accountability: Takes ownership of assigned transactions and ensures errors are followed through to successful processing.

Performance Measures / Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Accuracy and completeness of initial ERP batch uploads.
* Timeliness of batch upload processing.
* Percentage of transactions successfully processed on the initial upload.
* Timeliness of reviewing and communicating ERP-generated errors.
* Turnaround time for coordinating error corrections and resubmissions.
* Percentage of rejected transactions successfully resolved and posted.
* Number of outstanding or aged unresolved transactions.
* Accuracy and completeness of upload and error resolution tracking reports.
* Compliance with established procedures and internal controls.

Scope of Responsibility

This position is primarily responsible for the administrative execution of ERP batch uploads and the coordination of transaction error resolution. The role does not independently determine project accounting treatment, authorize project code changes, or make project financial decisions. Project controllers retain responsibility for validating and authorizing project-related corrections and providing direction when discrepancies require financial or project-specific judgment.

**Role Summary**

The Advisor, Employee Services role is part of the Employee Services team within LSEG's People Function. The role supports the delivery of a positive employee experience by providing timely, accurate, and employee-focused support through Live Agent channels. Working in a global environment, the role helps employees navigate HR processes, policies, and systems while contributing to operational excellence and continuous improvement.

  

Reporting to the **Manager, Employee Services** , you will serve as a primary point of contact for employees, managers, and key stakeholders, providing real-time advisory support on HR policies, processes, and Workday transactions across the end-to-end colleague experience lifecycle. You will own inquiries through to resolution, using ServiceNow, HRSD, and Workday to deliver an efficient and seamless service experience. The role requires building and maintaining strong partnerships with stakeholders across the People Function, demonstrating comprehensive knowledge of People Services Solutions (PSS) processes, and collaborating effectively with HR teams to ensure consistent, high-quality support. You will also contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, utilizing digital capabilities, automation, and AI-enabled solutions to enhance employee experience, service delivery, and operational effectiveness.

* Provide real-time support through Live Agent chat and other approved channels as a primary point of contact for HR inquiries.

* Resolve employee and manager questions related to HR policies, benefits, payroll, leave, time management, employee lifecycle transactions, and Workday self-service activities.

* Investigate moderately complex issues, determine appropriate resolutions, and assess potential downstream impacts.

* Apply HR policies, procedures, compliance requirements, and service standards consistently and accurately.

* Document and manage cases in ServiceNow, HRSD and Workday, ensuring complete and accurate records.

* Own inquiries through to resolution, providing timely updates and meeting service level commitments.

**Job Title:** **Staff Application Security Engineer**

**Job Location: Bangalore, India (Hybrid)**

Candidates must be based in or within reasonable commuting distance of Bangalore. This role requires the ability to be onsite in our Bangalore, India office as needed.

**ABOUT THE COMPANY:**

Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.

With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.

Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.

**THE OPPORTUNITY:**

As our Staff Application Security Engineer, you will be the technical authority for how Salesloft secures its SaaS applications, APIs, and microservice architectures. You will decide where and how security is built directly into the software development lifecycle (SDLC), so that engineering teams can ship features quickly without compromising safety. You will join our fast-growing, high-performing Security Engineering team.

A world-class revenue platform depends on security that is designed in from the start, not bolted on at the end. As release velocity increases and AI-enabled features and AI-assisted development reshape how software gets built, the core challenge is building guardrails that are automated, scalable, and trusted by the developers who use them.

On a day-to-day basis, you will:

* Architect scalable security controls for our web applications, microservices, and public and private APIs, including authentication and authorization frameworks, cryptography, input validation, and rate limiting.
* Automate security in the pipeline by embedding and tuning SAST, DAST, SCA, IAST, and secret scanning in CI/CD, using AI-assisted triage where it improves signal and speed.
* Lead threat modeling and design reviews with Product Managers and Engineering Architects during early feature design, including risks introduced by AI-enabled features.
* Drive remediation of complex vulnerabilities through deep-dive assessments, pen-test reviews, and bug bounty triage, partnering with engineering pods on root-cause fixes.
* Scale security awareness by developing developer-focused guidelines, delivering secure code training, and leading our Security Champions program across all product squads.

This role lives at the heart of how we Lead From the Front: you'll automate what's manual, prototype guardrails before polishing them, and put AI to work wherever it makes our engineers safer and faster. And in the spirit of how we Make Your Mark, you'll build security systems engineered to scale and stand on their own, shaping the architecture of an enterprise SaaS platform trusted by the world's leading revenue organizations.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:**

You are a deeply technical, proactive AppSec leader who combines a developer's mindset with an offensive security perspective. You excel at translating complex software risks into actionable developer guidance, building automated guardrails that developers love, and establishing technical standards that scale across distributed engineering teams.

You embody what we call Evidence Over Ego: you make decisions with data rather than instinct or seniority, and you give candid, constructive feedback that makes the work better. You bring systems thinking to everything you build, fixing root causes instead of patching symptoms, and you document your work so others can run with it.

If you're looking for a role where you can set the technical direction for application security at scale, this is the right move.

**THE TEAM:**

Our Security Engineering team is made up of seasoned and up-and-coming application security, cloud, and infrastructure engineers. We are results-oriented SaaS professionals with a deep passion for developer enablement and defense-in-depth. The engineers on our team are deeply curious, analytical problem-solvers who are highly collaborative and passionate about shipping secure software at velocity.

The team Moves as One — one group grounded in mutual trust and shared ownership, where we name tension directly instead of working around it. And we are relentlessly Customer-Inspired: every decision traces back to a single question — does this make our customers more successful and their data safer?

**THE SKILL SET:**

* 7+ years of professional experience in Application Security, Product Security, or Software Engineering with a strong security focus, within a modern cloud-native SaaS environment.
* Deep technical expertise in web application security, API security (REST/GraphQL), OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, secure design patterns, and modern authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, JWT).
* Proficiency reading and writing code in modern languages used in SaaS architectures (e.g., Python, Go, Java, TypeScript/Node.js, or Ruby).
* Proven experience building and scaling automated AppSec tooling (SAST, DAST, SCA, container scanning) in enterprise CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins).
* Strong capability to run threat modeling frameworks (e.g., STRIDE) and conduct architectural security reviews across complex microservice ecosystems.
* Track record of managing or triaging bug bounty programs (e.g., HackerOne, Bugcrowd) and converting vulnerability reports into systemic architectural fixes.
* Exceptional communication and developer-mentorship skills, with the ability to build trust and influence engineering pods without direct authority.

For more information about our company's comprehensive benefits please visit: https://salesloftbenefits.com/

At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings.
